source: CP8-15 append-only discovery plus primary source pp154-160

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: A published template modifies another specific original ship, with separate demonstrated values.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Record template mechanics as reusable transformation and preserve source sample as its own 104-claim publication identity.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not mutate or duplicate the ordinary V-19 source identity, or treat sample CL/HP as universal template constants.
cases.schemaPressure: Template rules object with separate sample/provenance and source conflicts.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Header Initiative +12; Skills Initiative +8.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Retain distinct header and skill observations, conflict status, edition page locator.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not normalize one value based on known skill math or call this PDF-certified without conflict.
cases.schemaPressure: Field evidence variant and explicit source conflict state.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Archaic penalties depend on opponent modernity; shields can fail 50% when SR exceeded.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Model condition predicates, failure chance, and critical-hit prohibition without changing base hull.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not always apply -2 attack, halve threshold for every encounter or replace SR 115 with halved shield.
cases.schemaPressure: Conditional rule triggers/effects across vehicle-to-vehicle encounter.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Rothana Heavy Engineering Acclamator-class Transgalactic Military Assault Ship
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Forgo all attacks as standard action; allied starships in 2-square-radius area receive Reflex +2.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Store action cost, exclusion of normal attack, area center/radius, friendly targeting, defense modifier.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not transform into passive aura or ship intrinsic Ref increase.
cases.schemaPressure: Typed area effect, target selector and turn activation state.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Rothana Heavy Engineering Acclamator II-class Transgalactic Military Assault Ship
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Forgo attacks as standard action; ships reduced to 0 hp in area are destroyed despite threshold.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent conditional consequence for affected ships, distinct from Acclamator I defensive grant.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not convert into added torpedo damage or unconditional destruction.
cases.schemaPressure: Area action with HP transition trigger and override of usual threshold survival.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Forgo attacks as standard action; enemy ships within 2 squares lose morale and insight bonuses to attacks, defenses and skill checks.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Model selective removal of tagged bonuses scoped to enemy ships.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not remove all typed bonuses or copy A-wing Int-jammer effect.
cases.schemaPressure: Tagged bonus suppression, enemy selector, area target.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Allied ships hitting targets in adjacent tactical-fire area gain one additional damage die.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Record success gate, allied attacker targeting, nonflat extra damage dice and adjacency radius.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not increase Carrack weapon profiles or grant unconditional +1 damage.
cases.schemaPressure: Post-hit damage-dice effect scoped by attacker/target.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Two crew; laser cannons pilot AND ion/torpedo gunner, with OR between those gunner families.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Persist pilot and dedicated gunner station, firing group alternatives and crew requirements.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not duplicate laser cannons because printed twice in separate alternatives or infer independent ion+missile gunners.
cases.schemaPressure: Nested AND/OR fire-group combinator with per-weapon operator.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: B-wing not-trained-in-Pilot penalty applies to pilot checks and Initiative; B-wing weapon swaps halve modification time.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Conditional piloting competency modifier and ship-family enhancement in repair/install workflow.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not bake -2 into printed statblock or change all starship modification times.
cases.schemaPressure: Condition-on-actor capability and ship-family modification multiplier.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Rothana Heavy Engineering Acclamator-class Transgalactic Military Assault Ship
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: 2 battery groups with 6 gunners each, while per-battery barrel/weapon count is unspecified.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Keep batteryGroupCount=2 and crewPerBattery=6 separate from unknown weaponCountPerBattery.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not infer 12 guns, six barrels/battery or six total batteries.
cases.schemaPressure: Separate physical mount count, gun count, crew slots, batteries and fire groups.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Ranged row names 2 ion cannons; attack profile gives a singular ion gunner/attack.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent printed two physical ion cannons and one listed attack profile without assuming attacks-per-round.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not derive 2 attack actions just from source label count.
cases.schemaPressure: Physical hardware/attack profile cardinality separation.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Two docking clamps accommodate two carried starfighters.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Use carried-craft attachments; count external clamps separately from weapon installations.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not import docked fighter armaments into Citadel statblock.
cases.schemaPressure: Ship-as-carrier external craft capacity and attachment slots.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Published upgrades add shields/maneuver and optional hyperdrive sled; stock lacks SR and built-in hyperdrive.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Version source stock separately from priced and rule-changing upgrades; use absence confirmed narrative vs not-stated.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant upgraded hyperdrive, astromech bonuses or new Dexterity to stock profile.
cases.schemaPressure: Variants and overlay patches attached to base vehicle.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Early ships depended on beacon ship for jump coordinates; later ships add onboard navcomputer.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Track temporal configuration qualifiers; statblock Hyperdrive x1.5 is not itself evidence of navcomputer.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not treat early beacon dependence or later navcomputer as universally installed gear.
cases.schemaPressure: Conditional navigation dependencies and variants.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Tractor beam battery displays damage em dash and grapple +52.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Store non-damage grapple-control profile independent of laser/ion damage dice.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not interpret dash as 0 damage attack or 5 tractor batteries as five grapple actions.
cases.schemaPressure: Typed non-damage weapon effect, target-size penalty and crew group.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Two point-defense battery rows contradict their Ranged declarations: +16/+14 and +14/+12 respectively.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Retain each named group header value and its corresponding subrow attack value with evidence and SOURCE_CONFLICT marker.
cases.forbiddenInference: Never resolve the attack bonus from attack math or select a favored line without Phase 2D.
cases.schemaPressure: Conflicting field-location evidence with independent status.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Tactical Fire forgoes attacks as standard action and prompts DC20 Pilot reaction for Gargantuan-or-smaller ships in radius at turn start or entry; failure takes 4d10x2 damage.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent a target-size, area-entry and timing-sensitive Pilot reaction, damage failure, and cost of source action.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not substitute allied buff, blanket area explosion, or automatic every-turn damage.
cases.schemaPressure: Target eligibility, event timing, actor action authority and skill reaction.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Dovin basal SR is organic and does not fall from ordinary shots; swift action selects speed +2 OR own SR +5 OR extra dovin basal damage die.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Distinguish nonstandard regenerating/unchanging shield semantics and mutually exclusive action-mode selection.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not apply normal SR -5 routine or stack all swift options.
cases.schemaPressure: Nonstandard defense engine interface plus activation modes.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Dovin basal can affect enemy shield SR only and can serve as a tractor beam; shield damage over SR reduces by 10 not 5.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Store damage-to-shield-only weapon mode, conditional shield erosion and alternate grapple role.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not inflict listed damage to hull as a conventional cannon or treat grapple as free damage.
cases.schemaPressure: Multi-mode weapon with damage target surface and tractor support.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Enemy ship computers do not recognize Coralskipper; lose ship Intelligence attack bonus until 1 minute/DC15 Use Computer reprogramming.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support detection-specific stat bonus exclusion and timed noncombat override of targeting status.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not remove unrelated attack bonuses or permanently apply universal stealth.
cases.schemaPressure: Per-target ship recognition, intelligence-dependent attack, repair action.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Different loadout configurations have max crew/passenger/cargo numbers and a separate typical armed configuration.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent explicit max, range and typical values tied to coherent configuration, not singular incompatible additive maxes.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not assign both maximum passenger and armament-heavy capacities to one inferred build.
cases.schemaPressure: Variants, loadout-dependent capacities.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: CR70 is explicitly unarmed; its disguised turbolaser housing spots hold escape pods; optional Vanguard C20 upgrade costs 500000 credits/2-3 weeks and changes base stats to CR90 without changing crew quality.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Certify zero installed weapons for stock, preserve family Tactical Fire statement separately, model optional retrofit as named transition.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not install CR90 turbolasers on unmodified CR70 or infer its unarmed status negates all nonattack actions.
cases.schemaPressure: Unarmed vehicle certification and family-scoped retrofit transformations.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Tactical Fire redirects attacks targeting nearby allied Colossal (frigate)-or-larger ships onto Dreadnaught itself.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent radius, eligible ally size, action cost and redirect-target authority separately from hit modifiers.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not treat this ability as auto +2 ally Reflex, damage absorption without retargeting, or universal redirect.
cases.schemaPressure: Hit-resolution interception with conditional targeting.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Unique Colossal (station) aggregates six detachable Dreadnaught-class cruisers around a shared central fuselage and has a separate full statblock.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Retain the one aggregate published identity and six conceptual subvehicles/detachability without synthesizing unprinted detached stats.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not multiply aggregate weapons or infer each detachable module has one-sixth of HP.
cases.schemaPressure: Composite modular vehicle and detachable attachment models.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Crew 0; shared family rule lets each installed weapon fire as though it had its own gunner, independent of normal crew stations.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent zero actual biological crew and virtual operator per mounted weapon group with droid mind-effect immunity.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not spawn human crew, treat crew 0 as cannot fire, or multiply installed hardpoints.
cases.schemaPressure: Zero-crew virtual station authority, shared droid traits.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Published as Huge starfighter / ground vehicle (walker), Speed 6 land + Fly16 character + Fly4 starship.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Allow a single publication identity to have dual locomotion modes, scale-specific speeds and corresponding type context.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not mark land speed as character-scale flying speed or create duplicate unrelated actors.
cases.schemaPressure: Mixed-mode vehicle movement validation.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Published full floorplan identifies Turret Access room #5, but gives no precise hardware/barrel count for gunner-operated double laser.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve room/deckplan location evidence and source-limited hardware scope separately.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not convert single turret access room into definitive one or two laser mounts.
cases.schemaPressure: Source floorplan provenance distinct from hardpoint count.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Kuat Systems Engineering Eta-2 Actis Interceptor
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Astromech grants alternative Mechanics/Use Computer +13, separate cover +5 and 10-jump memory; booster ring gives x1 hyperdrive and extended consumables; replacement missile option not stock.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support parallel conditional skills, cover by position, optional booster-ring dependent abilities and aftermarket replacement loadout.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant default onboard hyperdrive, astromech skills or missile weapons to stock fighter.
cases.schemaPressure: Conditional nested crew and subsystem configurations.

cases.sourcePrintedName: FreiTek Inc. E-wing Starfighter, Type B
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: +2 equipment bonus on Pilot checks with R7 or sufficiently modified astromech; conditional Mechanics and Use Computer (+13 versus +8).
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support companion-species/model/upgrade requirement distinct from base Pilot modifier and engine/crew permissions.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant +2 Pilot to E-wings with incompatible astromechs or every default E-wing.
cases.schemaPressure: Conditional crew-installed equipment modifiers.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Kuat Systems Engineering Firespray-31 Patrol Craft
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Stock pair of blaster cannons and tractor beam, three UNCOMMITTED emplacement points; six original prototype blueprints incl. Slave I are separate from stock.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent one stock configured ship, unspent emplacement capacity, and possible alternative blueprints without equating them.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not turn 3 unspent EP into 3 installed gun mounts, or import Slave I upgrades into stock.
cases.schemaPressure: Stock-vs-prototype configuration and unused upgrade capacity.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Proton torpedo row is a tracking beacon (4 payload), no damage, +5 Use Computer bonus when locating tagged target again.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Model non-damage hit-applies-target-marker and conditional later discovery bonus; use separate ammo stock.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not deal proton explosive damage or +5 to all Use Computer checks.
cases.schemaPressure: Post-hit target tag and follow-up search workflow.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Physical size/type Colossal space transport, treated as Gargantuan starfighter for being attacked by capital-ship weapons, dogfighting, and starship maneuvers.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Apply size override only to exactly three printed contexts; preserve physical size for other purposes.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not globally shrink the hull, change cargo/cover/weapon base, or override all size checks.
cases.schemaPressure: Contextual effective-size virtual type.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Geonosian Nantex has microscopic tractor-beam emitters that grant +1 equipment attack bonus vs targets <=2 squares; only laser cannons have attack row.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent range-gated attack equipment bonus without extra damaging or grapple tractor weapon.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not add an unprinted tractor attack roll or unconditional +1 accuracy.
cases.schemaPressure: Integrated subsystem passive aiming assist.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective Ginivex-class Starfighter
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: SR30 stock; deploying sail grants 15 extra points for SR45. Bonus layer depleted first; lost immediately on retraction; normal recharge.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support transient supplemental SR layer with separate depletion and retraction trigger.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not permanently set SR45 or subtract from base SR before supplemental SR15.
cases.schemaPressure: Conditional transient shield reserve and visual signature.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Capabilities expressly identify one double-laser emplacement, fixed-forward rather than turret; p89 floorplan #4 gunner station.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Allow source-certified one-emplacement physical mount, fixed-forward arc, and independently labeled operator evidence.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not infer a rotating turret from gunner station, multiply mount by number of barrels, or call arc unknown.
cases.schemaPressure: Positive mount certification using whole-source description and floorplan.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Printed two laser cannon batteries and two quad cannon batteries; crew requirements are four and two gunners, respectively; torpedoes have 8 payload.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Separate two firing battery group counts from uncertain number of barrels/weapons within each group.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not claim two/four total physical cannons based on number of gunners or batteries.
cases.schemaPressure: Physical barrel counts versus battery grouping.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: A modified Gozanti named craft: three added turbolasers, a second fire-linked torpedo launcher, SR50, cargo65, crew6, 24 torpedoes.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Keep unique identity with explicit physical evidence for turbolasers/launchers and named fields.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not replace the generic Gozanti statblock or copy all named upgrades to stock.
cases.schemaPressure: Named variants and evidenced hardware diffs.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Source explicitly states +2 trained Pilot benefit on proton torpedo attack rolls is already included in ship statistics.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent published attack as final value with bonus provenance, avoiding double application.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not add another +2 on top of printed +13 ship torpedo attack.
cases.schemaPressure: Derived attack provenance and included-modifier authority.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Eight double turbolasers are each independently gunner-controlled, expressly unable to fire as a single battery.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Record eight physical turbolaser emplacements and independent gunner stations, not a battery multiplier.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not combine eight guns into one battery attack or multiply the point-defense battery by independent turbolaser count.
cases.schemaPressure: Physical hardware and firing autonomy distinct from battery grouping.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Standard action forgo all attacks; adjacent allied ships gain +1 Reflex while adjacent enemies take -1 Reflex.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent affiliation-filtered simultaneous benefit and penalty in adjacent area with attack suppression.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant static shipwide defense or apply same sign to both allies and enemies.
cases.schemaPressure: Tactical Fire mixed-faction defense aura.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Four mass pulse mine tubes deploy 16 mines, each prohibiting hyperspace entry in a 4-square radius for 10 minutes.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Separate launcher count, carried payload, deployment location during movement, non-damaging area duration and hyperspace entry block.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not treat mass pulse tube as a damage attack or 16 deployers or allow affected ship to initiate hyperjump.
cases.schemaPressure: Expendable area-effect non-damage mines and hyperspace prevention.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Early Hapan Battle Dragons suffer -10 attacks if firing at more than one target per round; turbolasers fire no more often than every three rounds. Later ships upgraded.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Gate historical penalties/recharge to specifically early configuration, not all Battle Dragons.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not universally weaken the current published generic statblock or delete historical rule.
cases.schemaPressure: Era-/refit-specific limited target concurrency and cooldown.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Nova retrofit CL19 (stock CL17), carries 12 fighters rather than 24, 1-year consumables rather than 1 month, +10 SR on recharge-shields action; improved turbolasers.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Store alternate refit configuration with source-defined deltas and action-trigger shield change; preserve stock CL17.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not silently merge retrofit benefits, CL and payload into baseline record.
cases.schemaPressure: Alternative upgrades and action-gated SR restoration.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Tactical Fire: within 2-square radius, successful attack on enemy starfighter with damage at least target threshold imposes an EXTRA -1 condition step.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Resolve trigger per attack outcome and threshold before applying one additional CT step.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not apply CT movement automatically on any hit or add invented extra damage.
cases.schemaPressure: Threshold-triggered third-party tactical control.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Printed SR230 loses 5 points after every successful hit regardless of damage; any hit dealing damage exceeding current SR depletes all SR to zero.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent per-hit SR change and conditional catastrophic depletion, including nonpenetrating hits.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not use only ordinary DR/SR absorption or ignore passive shield loss.
cases.schemaPressure: Custom shield engine conditional depletion.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Kuat Drive Yards Imperial II-class Star Destroyer
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: p96 attack groups 5 heavy +5 standard turbolaser batteries, 2 tractor beam batteries; p97 narrative says twenty turbolaser batteries and ten tractor generators.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve both printed group counts and narrative hardware evidence without undocumented 1:1 conversion or override.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not equate a weapon-row group directly to a physical mount or mark numbers a contradiction before assessing grouping granularity.
cases.schemaPressure: Weapon battery fire group and physical generation hierarchy.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Kuat Drive Yards Imperial II-class Star Destroyer
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Standard action sacrifice all attacks: allies attacking targets within 2 squares of destroyer gain +2 attack.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Model action economy and ally/target spatial predicates, no continuous passive effect.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not add +2 on Imperial II own attacks or any target outside the radius.
cases.schemaPressure: Tactical Fire action-scoped offensive assistance.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Rendili StarDrive Victory II-class Star Destroyer
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Victory II is distinguished from Victory I by replacing limited ordnance with turbolasers and tractor beams; no missile attack or payload is printed for II.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Keep Victory II distinct and flag missiles as confirmed not listed, separate from an asserted numeric zero where no payload count is given.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not inherit Victory I torpedoes/conc missiles or gravity interdiction merely from the mission name.
cases.schemaPressure: Distinct hull variant and absent printed armament.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Kuat Drive Yards Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Printed Reflex 16 (flat-footed 47) is inconsistent on the source page.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve literal 47 in evidence, SOURCE_CONFLICT state, and require authoritative errata review before normalization.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not silently replace 47 with 14 or treat 47 as a verified workable defense bonus.
cases.schemaPressure: Malformed numerical printed statblock.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: p100 weapon line 4x4-square gravity-well area; p101 explanatory rules explicitly 3x3-square field, with attack vs Reflex 10.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve both source statements, flag conflict, avoid claiming one resolved area shape.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not erase 4x4 nor mechanically impose 3x3 without resolution.
cases.schemaPressure: Cross-page discrepant area targeting geometry.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Standard action forgo attacks; enemies moving into 2-square radius must pass Pilot DC20 or stop; once inside no new checks unless leave and reenter.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent zone entry vs remain-within state and once-per-entry condition; do not conflate with gravity well field.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not force repeated Pilot checks on every square/round inside zone.
cases.schemaPressure: Stateful entry-based movement suppression.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Immobilizer 418 is a refit of a Vindicator with heavy original batteries removed and four gravity generators installed; some Vindicators remain original.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Keep original Vindicator and rebuilt Immobilizer distinct identities/configurations with source provenance.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not add four gravity wells to all Vindicator hulls or remove their point-defense batteries.
cases.schemaPressure: Variant retrofit with equipment removal and role change.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Six flank-mounted double-laser turrets in prose; ONE double-laser battery attack statblock with six gunners.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Separate six physical turrets, one combined battery attack, and flank mounting without invented exact arc geometry.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not fabricate six independent attack rows or assume turret presence resolves all arc quadrants.
cases.schemaPressure: Positive physical count vs aggregate battery attack.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Printed Colossal space transport treated as Gargantuan starfighter only in three combat contexts; narrative explicitly pair of linked laser cannons.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve physical type and contextual effective type while recording pair of weapon systems and unconfirmed arc.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not globally reclassify craft to Gargantuan starfighter or make two separate extra attacks.
cases.schemaPressure: Contextual size and linked weapon mounts.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Junker generic template: condition track -1 step disables a d100-selected equipment system until CT recovers.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support status-dependent per-system disabling and system lookup plus absent-system no-op.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not turn condition change into permanent equipment destruction or randomly disable absent hardware.
cases.schemaPressure: Generic template actions and system-specific temporary disabled state.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Generic Junker modifications apply to TIE/In sample TYE-wing, whose header Init +2 vs Skills Init +8.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Keep base ship/template/sample as separate provenanced entities; retain two Initiative source readings.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not silently repair by calculation, treat Junker as 105th ship, or overwrite normal TIE.
cases.schemaPressure: Composite template provenance and conflicting duplicated stat.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Concussion missiles OR proton torpedoes OR shieldbuster torpedoes per mission; DC10 Mechanics and 5min for replacement.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support mutually exclusive weapon loads with equipment changes and inventory/speed constraints.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant all three attack options simultaneously or infer all launchers from torpedo stock.
cases.schemaPressure: Mutually exclusive equipment configuration and swap action.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: First-wave ships have no built-in armament; later generation adds two turrets and forward quad laser enhancement.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent version-specific weapons, optional payload and physical mounts without changing all K-wings.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not make two turret count a universal original ship characteristic.
cases.schemaPressure: Historical variant and installed weapons.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Header Init +10, Skills Init +6; Payload 6 plasma torpedoes vs Ranged shieldbuster torpedoes.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve both field conflicts separately with literal source values and pages.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not equate plasma and shieldbuster munitions without explicit source authority or silently rewrite Init.
cases.schemaPressure: Source disagreement on multiple mechanical field domains.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Three printed weapon attacks: battery two gunners, copilot cannon and pilot twin laser; p107 plan shows only one labelled gunnery station.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Separate station map, crew activities and attack groups; unknown numeric fire arcs stay source-silent.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not infer only one physical gun or use deck-plan interior station as an external gun arc.
cases.schemaPressure: Crew workstations vs firing groups and geometry.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Later Cygnus military Lambda version gets ten laser cannons; p106 base Sienar statblock differs.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Track optional/reprint variant with independent weapon config and source origin.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not insert ten cannons on printed base Lambda.
cases.schemaPressure: Variant weapons/provenance.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Sacrifice attacks as standard action: adjacent enemy Gargantuan-or-smaller starships SR halved while affected.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Model size predicate, area, lasting while inside and temporary SR modification.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not apply to capital targets, permanently destroy shields or treat as passive power.
cases.schemaPressure: Time-boxed temporary active aura with size gate.

cases.sourcePrintedName: Feethan Ottraw Scalable Industries Mankvim-814 Light Interceptor
cases.primarySourceObservedFact: One droid pilot in a physical cockpit; living pilot can take controls; ship no hyperdrive.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Distinguish replaceable droid crew position from fully autonomous fighter chassis; explicit absent hyperdrive.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not classify craft as zero-crew droid starfighter or grant a hyperdrive.
cases.schemaPressure: Cockpit/pilot type vs crew autonomy.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Forgo all attacks; adjacent allied Gargantuan or smaller ships receive +2 attack.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent affected ally size cap and spatial eligibility separate from hull attack options.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not buff all allied capital vessels or grant passive attack bonus.
cases.schemaPressure: Size-restricted active friendly aura.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Some Marauders remove double turbolasers and gain four concussion launchers; carried-fighter count can increase.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent retrofit swapping and capacity changes on a variant not base.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not stack launchers on top of base turbolasers or treat 36 fighters as stock.
cases.schemaPressure: Equipment removal/install paired with cargo/fighter configuration.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Ranged lists 4 point-defense double laser cannons, while single subrow describes a gunner, no arcs printed.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Preserve stated hardware four, per-group unknown details and unprinted arcs.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not assume one gun because one subrow or invent four independent gunners.
cases.schemaPressure: Weapon hardware count vs attack profile multiplicity.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Conditional droid changes Mechanics and Use Computer from +6 to +13, socket closed on later craft, and five-jump memory.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Store conditional equipment skills and coverage differences by generation.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant +13 checks or enclosed-droid cover when no appropriate astromech/variant.
cases.schemaPressure: Crew-dependent skill, cover and route capability.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Command version has third laser cannon, two ion cannons, second missile launcher.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Separate command configuration with extra hardware and correct cost/provenance.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant added guns to base Fighter.
cases.schemaPressure: Named command variant differentiation.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Bomber carries 32 missiles, with independent gunner and pilot roles, larger hull, different hyperdrive from light fighter.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Distinguish separate publication identity and weapons carried, preserve conditional astromech bonuses.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not inherit Fighter 6-missile stock or replace joint attack with fighter OR option.
cases.schemaPressure: Cross-variant identity and simultaneous crew weapons.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Three swift actions gain 10 SR instead of 5; Tactical Fire forgo attacks and gives allied ships within 2 squares +10 SR while cruiser SR >0.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Support conditional SR recharge and temporary protective ally aura, not a permanent passive upgrade.
cases.forbiddenInference: Do not grant unconditional +10 SR or remove action economy from shield recharge.
cases.schemaPressure: Shield engine / action dependency / conditional aura.

cases.primarySourceObservedFact: Home One is a subclass of MC80 with 120 fighters, six turbolaser and six heavy ion batteries vs stock MC80 36, four, five.
cases.requiredV06Behavior: Represent as source-backed variant with shared type family but its own published stats.
